method: Matched native CodeBuddy tool_use/tool_result IDs, explicit is_error=false, frozen canonical file path and source byte hash, then each numbered arrow line exact logical text. Remove only actual CR in CRLF line terminators and number wrapper; no Unicode/space normalization or self-report. Original bytes remain hashed unchanged. The pinned CodeBuddy display adds an empty numbered marker after requested slice or EOF; record outside requested coverage and never credit that line.
limitations: Administrative independent coverage comparison, not yet the new product checker.
Historical coverage/terminal ranges exactly limited by frozen policy; no complete old argv/result-string body claim.
One role cannot borrow another role read.
